method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A three-finger mitten and a slab torso as the subject.
notes.fix: Backlight the hand against the lit page and crop the torso to the cuff.

notes.problem: A two-finger mitten hand, a shapeless sleeve, a rigid sheet in the air.
notes.fix: Drop the person; a low raking close on the desk top with the sheet flat on the laminate.

notes.problem: A mitten hand and a flat black sleeve.
notes.fix: Tighter crop to lit knuckles and a cuff; a rim from the lid along the sleeve.

notes.problem: Low poly figures lit frontally, clock moire, the near screen under the cite line.
notes.fix: Rim light only from the window; raise the near desk's screen clear of the source band.

notes.problem: Clone mannequins, a mid tone floor, the cite line over the laptop.
notes.fix: Empty the room to seats, the lectern alone in the window's pool, the floor darkened.

notes.problem: Low poly mannequins lit enough to read as dolls; the cite line on the near laptop.
notes.fix: Backlight the room so the figures are pure silhouettes; crop the hero laptop off the corner.

notes.problem: Stacked floating slabs behind the desk; a curled seat lip.
notes.fix: Camera to about 1.2 m so the walk lies flat with contact at every joint; repair the seat shell lip.

notes.problem: A translucent dark rectangle at left; a jagged seat lip.
notes.fix: Remove or fog the occluder; fix the seat shell's front edge.

notes.problem: Grey slabs behind the desk read as a broken staircase.
notes.fix: Camera on the walk's axis or the out-of-pool pavers dropped below the light.
Pull back so paver 0 sits whole above the source band.

notes.problem: Hovering pavers on a water-like lawn, flat red inlays, a small desk.
notes.fix: Sunk pavers with soil joints, polished inlays, camera two pavers closer.

notes.problem: Desk small; grey-green lawn; 13 pavers in frame.
notes.fix: Pull back so all fourteen are in frame; the lawn outside the pool to near black.

notes.problem: Moire on far lids, flat lid cards, a blown hero top, rippled lawn, no seam.
notes.fix: Longer lens toward a visible seam, mip-mapped dim lids, the hero top exposed down.

notes.problem: Moire on the middle and far lids; a flat lawn under stamped tufts.
notes.fix: Plain dim far lids; fog past the sixth row.

notes.problem: A dark chair back as a dead bottom third.
notes.fix: Remove the chair from this camera or let the lid and page fill the lower two thirds.

notes.problem: A smear behind the kicker; a floating paver over a blank slab; the book tiny.
notes.fix: Push in to the close on the shut lid and the paperback; fog the oak behind the type.
